search_text: published ZDI-20-337 ZDI-CAN-9661 (Pwn2Own) TP-Link Archer A7 DNS Response Improper Input Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-03-25 CVE-2020-10885 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-10885 8.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['TP-Link'] ['Archer A7'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 AC1750 routers. title: (Pwn2Own) TP-Link Archer A7 DNS Response Improper Input Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link Archer A7 AC1750 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of DNS responses. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of DNS reponses prior to further processing. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of the root user.
